```sql
SELECT
  player_id,
  player_name,
  AVG(pts) AS points_per_game,
  AVG(reb) AS rebounds_per_game,
  AVG(ast) AS assists_per_game
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE played = 1
  AND game_date >= '2017-01-01'
  AND game_date < '2018-01-01'
  AND (LOWER(player_name) LIKE '%lebron%james%' OR LOWER(player_name) LIKE '%stephen%curry%')
GROUP BY player_id, player_name;
```
